game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling ash bricks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Sort falling ash bricks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round, ember hounds strike the smelter, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the smelter from ember hounds in Charred Forest: keep the sorted_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: sorted_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while sorted_ok > 0.
